title: BDL Basic Circular No. 168: Communicating to Banque du Liban the names of shareholders and persons holding managerial positions
text:
Basic Circular No. 168
Addressed to Banks, Finance Companies, Leasing Companies, Institutions that Issue
and Promote Charge and Credit Cards, Institutions Engaged in Electronic Financial
and Banking Operations, Money Dealers, and Specialized Lending Entities
(or Comptoirs)
Attached is a copy of Basic Decision No. 13638 of 4 June 2024, on Communicating to the
Banque du Liban the Names of Shareholders and Persons Holding Managerial Positions.
Beirut, 4 June 2024
The Acting Governor of the Banque du Liban
Dr. Wassim Manssouri

Basic Decision No. 13638
Communicating to the Banque du Liban the Names of Shareholders and Persons
Holding Managerial Positions
The Acting Governor of the Banque du Liban,
Pursuant to the Code of Money and Credit, in particular Article 70 thereof;
Pursuant to Law No. 44 of 24 November 2015 (Fighting Money Laundering and
Terrorist Financing);
Pursuant to Basic Decision No. 12147 of 22 December 2015 on The Implementation of
UN Security Council Resolutions No. 1267 (1999), No. 1988 (2011), and No. 1989 (2011),
and any related successor resolutions, attached to Basic Circular No. 136 to banks;
Pursuant to Basic Decision No. 12253 of 3 May 2016 on dealing with the U.S. Act of 18
December 2015 and its implementing regulations regarding the prevention of
Hizballah’s access to foreign financial institutions and other institutions, attached to
Basic Circular No. 137 to banks;
Pursuant to the FATF Recommendations; and
Pursuant to the Decision of the Central Council of the Banque du Liban, taken in its
meeting of 28 May 2024;
Decides the following:
Article 1:
All the institutions that are subject to a prior authorization from the Banque du Liban,
particularly banks, finance companies, leasing companies, institutions that issue and promote
charge and credit cards, institutions engaged in electronic financial and banking operations,
money dealers, and specialized lending entities (or comptoirs), must communicate to the
BDL Legal Department by 30 June 2024, an updated list prepared on Excel and sent to the
email address (legalsec@bdl.gov.lb), which includes the full name and date of birth of each
of the following:
- The shareholders and stockholders (as the case may be) that own more than 5% (five
percent) of shares and stocks.
- The beneficial owners that own and/or who exercise effective control over more than
5% (five percent) of shares and stocks.
- The Chairman and members of the Board of Directors.
- Any person in the Senior Executive Management.
1

The BDL may request the names of shareholders, stockholders, and beneficial owners that
own less than 5% (five percent) of shares and stocks, if the bank is not listed on the stock
exchange.
If the bank is listed on the stock exchange, the BDL may request the names of shareholders,
stockholders, and beneficial owners that own more than 2% (2 percent) of shares and stocks.
Article 2:
Banks, companies, and institutions mentioned in Article 1 above must provide the BDL Legal
Department with a new list upon any change in a previously sent list, within a week from the
occurrence of any change requiring the list amendment.
Article 2 bis1:
All institutions mentioned in Article 1 above must provide the BDL Legal Department with
the information required in Articles 1 and 2 above, in English, according to attached Forms
(1-2-3-4-5).
Article 3:
The BDL Legal Department shall continuously and periodically verify that the
aforementioned names are not designated on any UN, international, and national sanction
lists.
Article 4:
Banks, companies, and institutions mentioned in Article 1 above must comply with the
provisions of this Decision under penalty of having their license revoked.
Article 5:
This Decision shall enter into force upon its issuance.
Article 6:
This Decision shall be published in the Official Gazette.
Beirut, 4 June 2024
The Acting Governor of the Banque du Liban
Dr. Wassim Manssouri
